cleansingStrength.rationale: `moderate` by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2, one prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine@4, no prominent reinforcing route. TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate@16 is a strong anionic but after the E3 point (recorded, not reinforcing, C4). Sodium Xylenesulfonate@3 is a hydrotrope (no route).

conditioningLevel.rationale: `high` by C2: early (prominent) silicone Dimethiconol@6, plus cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@13, pearlizing Glycol Distearate@10 and a deliberate humectant route Panthenol@20 (own INCI entry, R11 list); supporting Dimethicone@11. Confidence moderate: the guar, pearlizer and the only humectant all sit after the fragrance marker (Panthenol near the end), so the C2 complement rests on late elements and realistic dose unknowns could leave one bounded silicone system (`moderate`).

wLineRecord.testedCandidate: Parfum@7 is the only candidate up to the cap: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> plausible; W-line = cap

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate — silicone system (Dimethiconol + Dimethicone) with a cationic guar; no lipid, no protein.
weightPotential.persistence: moderate — dimethiconol/dimethicone are persistent silicones, delivered by a guar coacervate; but no amino-silicone and no lipid.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate — C1 ether-sulfate chassis with a betaine buffer.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Two converging deposition families (silicone + cationic) — the convergence leg of the high anchor; silicones read wherever listed (W-LINE item 5).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone plus guar in an effective ordinary sulfate chassis plausibly leaves noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not `high`: W1 does not apply (no amodimethicone, set without amodimethicone creates no presumption), but the architecture is the same silicone+guar pairing that holdout-v3 settled at moderate in a sulfate/betaine base; no third family, no lipid, no W-RICH, reset not limited. Not `low`: two distinct deposition families, one a persistent silicone system (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: silicone and guar doses unknown; two-family convergence keeps `high` realistic.
weightPotential.rationale: `moderate`: silicone + cationic guar converge, ordinary C1 reset, no richness (6.6, W1 set note, W-RICH). Neighbor `high`.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional (formula-only): default `regular` (Section 9); every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction, all hidden in the blind pass. cleansingStrength `moderate` fixes which triggers remain possible: `treatment` fires only with a moderate/high-graded E2 dandruff claim (U3) — the formula half (Piroctone Olamine) is present; `alternating` impossible (not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.mildBase: excluded — Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 is a prominent strong anionic
scalpComfortTarget.rationale: `not_targeted`, decided by the formula: CSA FAILS — no E4 comfort or humectant/refatting route is prominent (Panthenol@20 is after Parfum@7; no Glycerin, no payload lipid). MB: excluded — Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 is a prominent strong anionic. Without a listed prominent route and without MB, even an explicitly positioned product is `not_targeted` (Section 10), so positioning cannot change the value; a sensitive/dry claim at reveal would trigger S-FAIL with the missing route named.
